posts.text: Next distribution: Wednesday, November 18, 3–5 PM at Wesley United Church. Please use the front entrance and bring receipts for the full amount of your gift card in a named zip-lock bag or envelope. Thank you to our donors and community for your continued support.
A sincere thank you to the Quoddy Quilters Guild for their generous donation, their kindness and their continued support of our community.
Thank you to the Ladies Night Golf group for their generous donation and for taking the time to give back to our community.
Thank you to everyone who organized and attended the clothing swap. Your participation supported sustainability, community and the joy of sharing.
